description: Tile size comparison: 512px vs 384px at N=1 level
method: Evaluate 512px detections on 384px tile grid (487 tiles) for same-area comparison

interpretation.image_track: 384px preferred — smaller tiles give clearer view of symbols (+0.06 to +0.08)
interpretation.text_track: 512px marginally better at N=1 — larger context helps text descriptions
interpretation.pipeline_argument: The text-track N=1 deficit is overcome by consensus+PV (F1=0.904 at 384px). 384px was the correct production choice because: (1) image detection is better, (2) more tiles per sheet gives finer spatial resolution, (3) the full pipeline compensates for the text N=1 deficit.

caveat: Cross-grid evaluation has methodological limitations: bootstrap CIs are unreliable due to sparse tile coverage. Point estimates are directionally clear but formal significance not established.
